objective: Reuse the Four-Russians pivot and combination-table allocations across blocks and calls in the matrix-F4 and inherited-F4 root kernels.

selected_policy.kernel: block-4 Four Russians elimination with a thread-local reusable pivot/table arena
selected_policy.pivot_storage: one retained Vec per pivot row, preserving the allocating implementation's locality

controls.KIC_F4_M4RI_ALLOCATING: 1 restores the pre-arena allocation policy in the same binary
controls.KIC_F4_DISABLE_M4RI_SCRATCH: 1 keeps one arena per matrix but disables reuse across calls
controls.KIC_F4_M4RI_BLOCK: selects a bounded block width from 2 through 10

fixtures.synthetic_kernel: sparse 129x257, dense 257x511, and rank-deficient 512x768 matrices, each in echelon and full-RREF modes

acceptance: arena and allocating implementations return byte-identical matrices, ranks, and word-operation counts for 96 exact cases
all six synthetic kernel cells have median speedup greater than one
all four real Semaev root cells have median speedup greater than one
frozen and holdout stage panels preserve every verdict digest, tree counter, matrix counter, and word-operation count
claim_boundary: Public-synthetic decomposition-stage engineering evidence only. The retained result changes allocation overhead, not the Macaulay row space, solver tree, relation yield, asymptotic complexity, Pollard-rho comparison, external-target capability, or any key-recovery result.
